name: calm-aside
description: Calm Aside: a read-only side chat. /aside opens a pane where you ask about the session so far; a tool-less fork of the session answers, and nothing goes back into the main chat.

cyberpunk.title: Cyberpunk theme
cyberpunk.description: Neon pink titles, cyan accents and yellow alerts, like Calm Mode's Cyberpunk theme.

showCost.title: Show cost line
showCost.description: Under each answer, a dim line with how long it took and the tokens it read from the cache, added and wrote.

liveFallback.title: Answer before the first reply
liveFallback.description: Before Claude has answered once there is nothing to fork. On: answer at once from the chat's text with a small model (not cached, marked 'quick'). Off: wait and answer when Claude's reply ends.

liveModel.title: Model for quick answers
liveModel.description: The model for quick answers before the first reply (a --model value). Fork answers always use the session's model.

maxHistory.title: Side questions kept
maxHistory.description: How many earlier side questions and answers are shown and sent along with each new question (1 to 50).
